free_tier.stated: Cyber v1 is free from the Nodecode CLI once your account has topped up at least $2 (or €2). The top-up stays in your balance.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI-compatible key plus the vendor's own clients
chaining: The free allowance is real but gated behind a small payment and limited to one model through the vendor CLI; other clients get 403.

limits.value: 10M tokens per 24 hours; 30 requests per minute; 2 requests at once; one model, CLI only

identity_cost.detail: a card top-up of at least USD 2 or EUR 2 is required before the free key is issued

reliability_note: 429 free_daily_used and free_rate_limited with Retry-After; 503 free_capacity_busy when paid calls take capacity

evidence.proved: a free Cyber v1 key exists but requires a USD 2 or EUR 2 top-up and is limited to 10M tokens per day
